'''Yō Kitazawa''' (Japanese: '''北沢洋''' ''Kitazawa Yō'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Kitazawa was born on July 9, 1963, in {{wp|Saitama Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He became a voice actor as an adult and mostly got minor roles. He provided the voice of [[Ninja Village]] elder {{kal|Hanzo}}, during {{aniseries|XY}} of the {{pkmn|animated series}}. Kitazawa is currently affiliated with Ken Production.
